purpose: Studio-wide open-source expansion map. Candidates are promoted independently per capability and never replace the canonical deterministic path without evidence.

evidenceGates.license: record upstream license and model/data terms
evidenceGates.realInput: exercise against representative TRIPPEDD media or production artifact
evidenceGates.measurement: capture runtime, throughput, output metrics and resource use
evidenceGates.recovery: kill/fail/resume test without invalidating completed work
evidenceGates.canonicalCompatibility: preserve PhysicalSourceTimeline, editorial separation and artifact contracts
evidenceGates.regression: prove existing canonical path remains green

canonicalRules: Never make an optional OSS tool a single point of failure.
Keep expensive analysis/render stages resumable and cacheable.
Physical source truth remains authoritative for physical events.
Story Runner and Autonomous share physical-source evidence but retain independent editorial interpretation.
UNKNOWN telemetry is never treated as healthy progress.
Hosted GitHub Actions remains first choice until budget/capacity bounds are demonstrated; local/farm backends are measured failover paths.
Do not merge an entire stale branch when only a capability is valuable; extract and reconcile the capability.

priorityQueue.nextGate: isolated real Blender render with worker failure/resume
real dialogue fixture with measurable segmentation/separation
real source-to-artifact pipeline with independent QC
live production telemetry retrieval plus restart/recovery evidence
